notes: Stader PermissionedNodeRegistry (solc 0.8.16). Source loops, all shown as whiles: whitelistPermissionedNOs (455), addValidatorKeys key loop (2124), allocateValidatorsAndUpdateOperatorId for over operators and the do-while (1312/1360/1394), markValidatorReadyToDeposit front-run and invalid-signature loops (1140, 1185), withdrawnValidators (741), getTotalQueuedValidatorCount (346), getOperatorTotalNonTerminalKeys (995, also inlined in addValidatorKeys at 1969), getAllActiveValidators (1481), getValidatorsByOperator (1781), StringsUpgradeable.toHexString in the AccessControl reverts. Implicit: bytes[] ABI encodes into external calls (P7), rotated new-array initialisations `while idx - 1` (P3). P4: mappings keyed by concat(mem[0]) (pubkey hashes). Long functions (addValidatorKeys 377 lines, getAllActiveValidators 289) reviewed by structure.
summary: Good text: all twelve source loops, including a do-while, appear as whiles with readable bounds; minor issues are difference-style loop conditions, P4 mapping keys and implicit copy loops.
